nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_stamp: Seal Magic: Sealing Stamp - a small seal is thrown at the first foe it meets and bursts there: the foes in 1.5 blocks take a light hit, a mage among them finds the grimoire shut for two seconds (a boss for one), and all are slowed. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.sealing_needles: Seal Magic: Sealing Needles - four needles of sealing light fly out and seek the nearest foes; each hit is small but cuts the foe's casting for one and a half seconds (Magic Jamming). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_ward_mark: Seal Magic: Ward Mark - a ward is sealed onto your own skin: a seal laid on you by another mage breaks at once, and for eight seconds you have Absorption II and Resistance I.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_rune_lattic: Seal Magic: Rune Lattice - a lattice of runes unfolds in a wide cone ahead of you: every foe in it takes a hit, is slowed (Slowness III, 2.5 s) and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_gate_closin: Seal Magic: Closing Gate - the seal that shuts what is open is thrown down a 14 block line: every foe on it is hit, shoved back and has its casting shut for 2.5 seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.protective_seal: Seal Magic: Protective Seal - a ward seal on you and up to five allies within eight blocks: Absorption II and Resistance I for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_sigil_burst: Seal Magic: Sigil Burst - a sigil is laid where you look and bursts: foes within 4.5 blocks are hit, pushed away and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_sigil_field: Seal Magic: Sigil Field - a field of sigils lies for four seconds where you look; every half second the foes inside take a pulse, are slowed and cannot cast. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.seal_pillars: Seal Magic: Pillars of Seal - six pillars of sealing light rise one after another along a 12 block line ahead of you: every foe on it is hit, thrown up a little, slowed and cannot cast for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_sealing.forbidden_seal_a: Seal Magic: Forbidden Seal Art - the art that sealed a devil, aimed at the foe in your crosshair (18 blocks): it and the foes within five blocks of it are struck hard, rooted (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, shortened for players and bosses), their grimoires shut for up to eight seconds and their casting cut. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_leather_lash: Skin Magic: Leather Lash - the skin of your arm is stretched and cracked like a whip across a four block cone: foes in it are hit and shoved back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_hardened_hide: Skin Magic: Hardened Hide - your skin hardens for five seconds: Resistance II, but you are stiff (Slowness I). Meant for the blow you can see coming.
nusmp.page.book_skin.soft_skin: Skin Magic: Soft Skin - your skin goes soft as rubber for eight seconds: Absorption III soaks the next blows and you fall slowly. The other half of the hide: it takes what a hard skin would turn.
nusmp.page.book_skin.peeling_skin: Skin Magic: Peeling Skin - four flaps of your own skin peel off and fly after the nearest foes; each hit weakens its target for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_bristling_hide: Skin Magic: Bristling Hide - for ten seconds your skin bristles with hard scales of skin: your melee hits deal extra damage and whoever strikes you is pricked back. Bonus scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_graft: Skin Magic: Skin Graft - fresh skin is grafted over every wound: all harmful effects leave you, a broken seal on you is undone and a fifth of your health returns (the heal decays if you were healed a moment ago).
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_stretch: Skin Magic: Stretching Skin - your skin is pulled out like a sling and snaps you nine blocks forward; everything you pass through is hit and shoved aside. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_wrap: Skin Magic: Skin Wrap - a sheet of skin wraps the foe in your crosshair and holds it still (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one) and weakens it. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_blistering_fie: Skin Magic: Blistering Field - the ground you point at becomes a field of raw, blistering skin for four seconds; every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_skin.skin_cast_off: Skin Magic: Cast-Off Skin - you shed your whole skin in a blast: foes within six blocks are hit hard, thrown back and weakened. The empty skin draws every hunter off you while you slip away unseen for four seconds with Speed II and Absorption II. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_lash: Tongue Magic: Tongue Lash - your tongue shoots eight blocks ahead and lashes every foe on the line, slowing it for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_snatch: Tongue Magic: Tongue Snatch - the tongue hooks the foe in your crosshair (14 blocks), hits it and reels it to you (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock; a boss is hit but not pulled). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_acid_spit: Tongue Magic: Acid Spit - a gob of acid spat at the first foe or wall it meets; the foes in 1.5 blocks are hit and poisoned for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_whip_crack: Tongue Magic: Whip Crack - the tongue is swung round in a wide arc and cracks across a six block cone: every foe in it is hit and thrown back hard. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_swing: Tongue Magic: Tongue Swing - the tongue sticks to the block or foe you aim at (3 to 22 blocks) and drags you across, with Slow Falling for 2.5 seconds. A way across, not a weapon.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_savouring_: Tongue Magic: Savouring Lick - a long wet lick across a short cone: foes in it are hit and a little of their life flows to you (the heal decays like every heal). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_numbing_sa: Tongue Magic: Numbing Saliva - a glob of numbing saliva flies to the first foe or wall and bursts over three blocks: foes in it are hit, slowed (Slowness III) and weakened for three seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.wrapping_tongue: Tongue Magic: Wrapping Tongue - the tongue winds round the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks) and holds it fast (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_lashing_ba: Tongue Magic: Lashing Barrage - five lashes in a row on the foe in your crosshair, a quarter of a second apart, each a little shove; together they hit for a bit more than one big blow. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_tongue.tongue_great_swal: Tongue Magic: Great Swallow - the tongue snares the foe in your crosshair (14 blocks), drags it to your feet and hits it hard; two thirds of a second later the maw closes on it again for half as much, and you are healed a little (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock; a boss is bitten but not dragged). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_plac: Switching Magic: Place Swap - you and the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks) trade places in the blink of an eye, and it is slowed for a second and a half. Fails if either spot would be inside a wall.
nusmp.page.book_switching.blink_switch: Switching Magic: Blink Switch - you swap your place with an empty spot seven blocks ahead (the furthest free one, never inside a wall). A pure move, no damage.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_inve: Switching Magic: Inversion Pulse - the push is switched for a pull: foes within 4.5 blocks are hit and dragged in towards you instead of thrown away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.ailment_swap: Switching Magic: Ailment Swap - up to three harmful effects on you (poison, slowness, weakness ...) are switched onto the foe in your crosshair, for at most five seconds and the second level; it also takes a light hit. Fails if you carry none.
nusmp.page.book_switching.aggro_switch: Switching Magic: Aggro Switch - the hatred of up to six creatures within ten blocks is switched: each turns on the next one instead of on you, and is dizzy for two seconds. Players and bosses are not switched. Needs two creatures.
nusmp.page.book_switching.foe_swap: Switching Magic: Foe Swap - two foes near the point you look at trade places and are dizzy for two and a half seconds, each taking a hit: the archer stands in the front line and the brute behind it. Needs two foes and room for both.
nusmp.page.book_switching.up_down_switch: Switching Magic: Up-Down Switch - up and down trade places for the foes within four blocks of the point you look at: they are hit and float up for a second. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.switching_tang: Switching Magic: Tangle Field - left and right are switched in a field you lay where you look for four seconds: every half second the foes inside take a pulse, are dizzy and stumble towards the middle. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.shuffling_barr: Switching Magic: Shuffling Barrage - five switch-marks fly after the nearest foes; each hit drags its target a step towards you instead of away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_switching.grand_reversal: Switching Magic: Grand Reversal - everything within eight blocks is switched: every foe (up to ten) takes the place of the next one, whatever it was doing, and is hit and dizzy for four seconds. Needs two foes; a foe whose new place is inside a wall stays where it was. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_door: Recombination: Door Slam - a door of the magic house swings out of nowhere and slams across a four block cone: foes in it are hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_plan: Recombination: Plank Volley - three planks torn from the house fly out in a fan 14 blocks long; a foe on any of them is hit once. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_stai: Recombination: Stair Leap - a flight of stairs forms under your feet and throws you up and forward; you fall slowly for two seconds. A way up a ledge or over a gap.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_chim: Recombination: Chimney Cannon - a chimney of the house is turned on its side and fires a beam of mana 18 blocks: every foe on the line is hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_trap: Recombination: Trapdoor - the floor under the point you look at is recombined into a trapdoor: foes within 3.5 blocks drop, are hit and slowed (Slowness IV, 3 s). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_scaf: Recombination: Scaffold Span - scaffolding is built under you and up to five allies within eight blocks: Speed I, Jump Boost II and Slow Falling for eight seconds.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_roof: Recombination: Roof Slam - a roof tears off the house and comes down on the point you look at: foes within five blocks are hit hard, slowed and thrown outward. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_hall: Recombination: Hallway Maze - the rooms of the house are shuffled into a maze at the point you look at for four seconds: every half second the foes in it take a pulse, are slowed and lose their way (dizzy). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_recombination.house_coll: Recombination: House Collapse - the magic house is pulled apart over the point you look at and drops: after a warning of under a second everything within seven blocks is hit very hard, slowed and thrown up and out. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_c: Transmutation: Copper Bolts - a bolt of transmuted copper flies to the first foe or wall and bursts; the foes in 1.2 blocks are hit and weakened for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_s: Transmutation: Sand Shower - the air ahead is turned to a spray of sand across a five block cone: foes in it are hit and blinded for two seconds. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_r: Transmutation: Rubber Spring - the ground under you is turned to rubber and throws you high into the air; you fall slowly for four seconds, so the landing is soft.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_l: Transmutation: Lead Weights - the foe in your crosshair is turned heavy as lead: it is held in place (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, three seconds on a player, a boss for one) and weakened. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_b: Transmutation: Brass Whips - a wide band of air is turned to brass and cracked down a ten block line: every foe on it is hit and thrown back. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_s: Transmutation: Salt Flats - the ground you look at is turned to salt for five seconds; every half second the foes on it take a pulse, are slowed and wither. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_i: Transmutation: Iron Rain - the sky above the point you look at is turned to iron and falls for four seconds: every third of a second the foes in 4.5 blocks take a pulse and are jolted. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.living_sta: Transformation: Living Statue - everything within five blocks of the point you look at is changed to stone: the foes there are hit very hard and stand frozen, weak and clumsy (hard control: shares the twelve-second lock, four seconds on a mob, three on a player, a boss for one). Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_hand_sway: A hand drawn across the air in a slow arc: the flow leaves it as a cone of water four and a half blocks long, hits every foe in it and slows it for a second and a half. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_heel_stamp: The heel comes down once and the floor answers: a ring of water bursts round you, hits the foes within three and a half blocks and pushes them away. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_mirror_step: The dancer steps through the foe like a reflection and comes out behind it: you blink behind the foe in your crosshair (16 blocks), hitting everything on the way. Fails with no foe in sight or no room behind it. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_serpent_arm: The arm winds out nine blocks like a snake of water and coils back: every foe on the line is hit and drawn in towards you. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_echo_step: The dancer leaves an ink afterimage where they stood and is gone: mobs hunting you lose your trail, you are unseen for three seconds and quick (Speed I).
nusmp.page.book_butoh.butoh_crescendo: The dance builds beat by beat round you for four seconds: every half second the foes within five blocks (the field moves with you) take a pulse, lose their rhythm (Magic Jamming) and are slowed. Damage scales with your EP.
